for r in "${PLUGIN_ROOT:-}" "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT:-}"; do [ -f "$r/scripts/run.sh" ] && exec sh "$r/scripts/run.sh" codex-hook prompt; done; exit 0
for r in "${PLUGIN_ROOT:-}" "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT:-}"; do [ -f "$r/scripts/run.sh" ] && exec sh "$r/scripts/run.sh" codex-hook stop; done; exit 0
